title: Research: read-only transported shears for the native covariant reader
body:
PR2742 leaves a transported subtraction requiring a complete native word. This supplies `(X,W) -> (X,W ± P^t X)` for all four phases of its actual covariant action, with **X read-only at every prefix**, arbitrary dirt in both 704-field banks, no extra algebraic field and no CLEAR. Opposite-sign subtraction restores W exactly.

**Status: finite interface construction / research result; no new κ.** Quarter-turn scalar operations fall **3,336 → 1,732** against the full sandwich, or **2,664 → 1,732** against a stronger comparator that already removes avoidable data permutations. The additional saving against that comparator is 932 operations (about 35%) and 7,360 retained real-component primitives. All 240 native monomial traversals remain charged. These are exact instruction counts, not a measured runtime speedup or an optimum.

The mechanism uses the existing eight helper pivots as reversible destination accumulators. It conjugates the accumulator around two complete source-load passes, preserving the source throughout. The proof, literal compiler, complete local recurrence, logical access invoice and sufficient local precision bound are in `research/covariant-transported-shear/`. Only that directory changes: 17 files, 2,208 added lines, including six unchanged predecessor exports and the exact receipt. Generated instruction dumps are not committed.

The recursive histogram is unchanged. The explicit reader-prefix implementation of the typed echo retains four prefixes, containing rank mass 4,640 before additional obligations. No centre-child deletion, complete supplier moment, physical streaming layout or improvement over the newer T74 κ claims is asserted. Matching bank types/ownership, physical movement and buffers, complete rounded precision, the consumer and supplier/outer admission remain separate.

### Evidence

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/covariant-transported-shear
```

Expected: `PASS_READONLY_TRANSPORTED_SHEAR`, `PASS_INDEPENDENT_TRANSPORTED_SHEAR`, and the registered-package pass with `no_new_kappa`.

- All eight phase/sign words agree with two complete comparators on all 1,408 arbitrary input columns over Q[z]/(z^4−1). Literal inverse and opposite-sign restoration are checked separately.
- A separately written checker reconstructs the reader forward, inverts B, derives the block oracle and interprets all emitted words; 22,998 nonzero formal terms agree. It imports neither primary replay nor predecessor mathematical code.
- All 448 intermediate data-frame pairs pass. The original source-bound native adapter/query/global-phase checks are rerun unchanged.
- Semantic controls reject missing dirty-helper loads, wrong signs/orientation, missing uncompute and work/source confusion. An endpoint-correct transient source write is rejected by the stronger prefix contract.
- Registered CPython 3.12.14 replay and seven behavioral groups pass, including optimized Git-free replay, unchanged file hashes, typed-receipt/source corruption and preloaded-module controls. Timestamp-valid stale-bytecode positive controls demonstrate direct execution of authenticated dependency bytes; predecessor assertions remain enabled under `-O`.
- Selected source-binding and ceiling orientation checks, indexed predecessor-byte checks and whitespace checks pass. A full selected cold replay was not required or run for this additive local construction. Hosted CI is separate.

Scientific base: `7981b35eb209d0808fe2066bd928cbeff94d00fe`, priority 5, fresh OS seed 50. Rebased onto canonical `df801f6da7b9aa8e01bd35decde7b1b1d45eec08` with guidance, selection, runner and all consumed inputs unchanged. Contribution head: `65da5e0c269346b00c2f389debfcb3a34d7590c6`. The exact dependency is Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml's PR2742 `8571b04372f539b725e7f27d1ab00c506ca616fd`; its source exports remain byte-identical, with original Git-blob and SHA256 pins.

Credit Jose Manuel for P, the helper chart and native covariance; ywz65 for the full dirty reader; Ross Richardson for the section and typed-cost distinction; Cinna Davis and Aaron Wang for the echo/phase-window lineage; Ali Romman for the native tools; and the retained selected construction lineage. The contemporaneous PR2788 stale-bytecode finding prompted the authenticated-byte loading adapter and controls. New work by Tekalign (@tekuuu) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; no independent human review or formal-kernel proof claimed.

[Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2488#discussioncomment-18959657). The initial destructive reset did not meet dirty-work restoration; the one pivot was this source-preserving shear. Final metadata refresh covered 728 open PRs through #2801 and the recent canonical Discussion2488 claims; broad Discussion refresh timed out. No matching construction was found within that coverage, which is not a novelty certificate. Supplier expansion is stopped until a consumer actually deletes a priced child.

### Merge danger

Two-way door; additive research package only. Frozen sources, existing tools and the selected frontier are unchanged.
